archive_manifest.issue: Alternate page with proper canonical tag

not_found_404.description: Pages returning HTTP 404 status codes. Includes legacy flat radar URLs, renamed series chapters, and removed tags.

crawled_not_indexed.description: Pages crawled by Googlebot but excluded from index due to low content density, thin taxonomy tags, or newly published queue.

excluded_noindex.description: Pages excluded due to meta robots noindex tag. Predominantly intentional tag archives, plus accidental flags on production articles.

page_with_redirect.description: Pages that issue HTTP 301/302 redirects. Includes trailing slash normalizations, protocol/subdomain upgrades, and restructured slugs.

blocked_robots.description: Pages disallowed by robots.txt directives. Contains intentional XML feed and API blocks, plus historical tag crawl artifacts.

canonical_alternate.display_name: Alternate page with proper canonical tag
canonical_alternate.gsc_issue: Alternate page with proper canonical tag
canonical_alternate.description: Pages recognizing an alternate canonical URL. Covers www subdomain consolidation and external utility canonical pointers.
